item.title: 🔴 Microsoft Patches Record 974 Vulnerabilities, Including Two Exploited Zero-Days
item.description:
Why this matters: Hospitality-system impact — consider guest services, PMS/POS, and property operations.

The record-breaking September security update fixes two exploited privilege-escalation zero-days and 20 potentially wormable vulnerabilities.

The post Microsoft Patches Record 974 Vulnerabilities, Including Two Exploited Zero-Days appeared first on SecurityWeek.
